mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_step_run (run_id, step_id, step_name, step_order, step_type, tool_name, status, output_summary, error_message, cost_millis, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{runId}, #{stepId}, #{stepName}, #{stepOrder}, #{stepType}, #{toolName}, #{status}, #{outputSummary}, #{errorMessage}, #{costMillis}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, step_id, step_name, step_order, step_type, tool_name, status, output_summary, error_message, cost_millis, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time FROM ai_agent_step_run WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY step_order ASC, create_time ASC
